summary: Backend PDF import via Gemini LLM feature tested end-to-end. All 5 tests PASSED: async POST returns 200 immediately (0.2s) with status=processing; polling GET reaches import_status='done' with 99 tasks extracted from real Amaralina Star Thruster Overhaul PDF; task structure valid (name, duration_value, duration_unit, dates, progress, parent_id hierarchy); empty file → 400; invalid PDF bytes → 400; supervisor without shared_with → 403; admin with permission → 200 async.

minor.issue: GET requests time out (>30s) while background LLM (_do_import via asyncio.create_task) is running — suggests LiteLLM/emergentintegrations call is blocking the event loop, degrading concurrent request handling. The endpoint itself works (POST responds in 0.2s and GET works once LLM finishes), but polling from frontend needs a generous timeout. Consider running the LLM call in a thread executor or using an async LiteLLM client.

action_items: OPTIONAL: run the Gemini LLM call in a thread executor (asyncio.to_thread) or ensure LlmChat uses a non-blocking backend, so GET /projects/{id} polling isn't starved during import (current LLM run ~60-70s blocks concurrent requests on same worker).
OPTIONAL: frontend polling interval should be >=5s with request timeout >=30s to survive backend saturation during LLM call.
critical_code_review_comments: asyncio.create_task(_do_import(...)) — good for fire-and-forget, but the underlying LiteLLM completion() call appears to block the event loop. Consider `await asyncio.to_thread(chat.send_message, ...)` if the client is sync.
raw_text truncated to 12000 chars — reasonable safeguard against context overflow.
Exception path in _do_import correctly persists import_status='error' with import_error message.
PDF parsing with PyMuPDF (fitz) is synchronous inside the request handler; acceptable since it's fast, but for very large PDFs could be moved to thread executor.
seed_data_creation: Test creates one TEST_ImportPDF_Amaralina project per module and deletes it at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF import feature is working. Real PDF (Amaralina Star Thruster) yields 99 hierarchical tasks via gemini-3-flash-preview (~60-70s LLM latency). Backend URL: https://twas-repair-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_import_pdf.py. PDF cached at /tmp/amaralina.pdf. If backend restarts (hot reload) mid-test, background asyncio task is lost and import_status stays 'processing'.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works. Minor observation: LiteLLM sync call inside asyncio.create_task appears to block event loop for ~60s (GET requests time out during that window). Not a functional bug but a scalability concern.
